differences.projects: An object-shaped inline itemSchema becomes a class named after the operation (ImportLogsRequestStreamItem), and every element class is tagged x-apiome-stream-kind.
differences.catalog: The inline element stays on the message (extras.streams) with its stream kind; the kind is recorded per media type on the message, not on the type. The element is not the message payload, and the source itemSchema is written back on export.

differences.projects: Every tag field (name, summary, description, parent, kind, externalDocs) is stored on the project's x-apiome-tag-taxonomy, and a schema's x-tags / x-tag / tags are listed on the class as x-apiome-tags.
differences.catalog: parent, summary and kind are kept on the model's tag hierarchy and a tag's description on its service; externalDocs and a schema's x-tags stay in the preserved source and are written back on export.

differences.projects: A summary written beside a $ref stays on the property.
differences.catalog: The summary stays in the preserved source and is written back on export; the sibling description becomes the field's description on both paths.

differences.projects: Sources resolve only against the documents supplied with the import; an AsyncAPI step in an Arazzo 1.1 document is left not-applicable for the server.
differences.catalog: Sources resolve against the fileset, then the catalog, then (when allowed) a remote fetch; steps resolve against the operations imported in the same scan, and AsyncAPI steps link to their channel. An unresolved step names its reason as a code (unknown-operation, ambiguous-operation).
